family.description: This domain family consists of a group of uncharacterized proteins, typically between 99 to 116 amino acids in length, found in bacteriophages that infect Microbacterium and Arthrobacter bacterial hosts. These proteins are encoded in the genomes of phages belonging to the Caudoviricetes class, primarily within the families Azeevirinae, Dismasvirus, Yangvirus, Manhattanvirus, Liebevirus, Zetavirus, and Armstrongvirus. An AlphaFold prediction shows these proteins are composed of two alpha helices. AlphaFold also predicts that these proteins likely form homodimers.
family.name: Domain of unknown function (DUF7169)
